items.title: Let's Open Source the World — Brandon Thomas, ArtCraft
items.content_snippet: ArtCraft’s first Photoshop approximation took about 24 hours to build, Brandon Thomas says. At CODE Summit 2026, he explains how Rust and AI coding agents power open source alternatives to Adobe’s creative tools, Microsoft Office and Figma. MCP and CLI automation, Linux support, reusable UI components and CI bottlenecks lead into Autocraft, a forthcoming software factory for issue triage, agentic development, evaluations and post training. Speaker info: - https://github.com/echelon - https://x.c

items.title: I love you so jevving much — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe AI
items.content_snippet: Being Einstein 95% of the time and Mr. Bean 5% is Diogo Almeida's analogy for unreliable LLM automation. At CODE Summit 2026, the TypeSafe AI cofounder argues that RLHF optimizes models for human assistance and makes the case for machine native AI with Jev. Reliable agents, KV cache limits, shared memory, semantic types and real time security point toward what software engineers could build beyond chatbots. Speaker info: - https://www.linkedin.com/in/diogomda - https://x.com/CompleteSkeptic - ht
